name: Needle Rush Point
description: Needle Rush Point is located on Perdido Key with direct frontage on both the Gulf of America and Ole River. With over 700 feet of private beach front and over 500 feet on Ole River with two boat docks and an observation dock there is no better place for your vacation! All of our 100 units are privately owned and individually decorated and have unobstructed views of either the Gulf or Ole River. Our guests enjoy the choice of spending time at the beach, either the gulf or river side pools, tennis / pickleball courts, and grilling areas. We also have large lawns directly behind all buildings providing additional areas for recreation. There are two docks for boats, one for sitting, and a boat & trailer storage area. All of these are first come first serve.
